name: SubmitMediaComprehensionJob

parameters.help_en:
The input material. It is a JSON string with the following structure:

Medias (Array<Object>, required): The list of media assets. It contains 1 to 10 elements. Each element includes the following fields:
Type (String, required): The type of the media asset. Valid values: video and image. The value is not case-sensitive.
Url (String, mutually exclusive with MediaId): The URL of the media asset. It must start with http:// or https:// and be up to 2,048 characters in length. Unregistered URLs are automatically registered as media assets.
MediaId (String, mutually exclusive with Url): The ID of the registered media asset. If both Url and MediaId are specified, MediaId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
输入素材，JSON 字符串，结构如下：

Medias（Array<Object>，必填）：媒资列表，1~10 个元素，每个元素包含
Type（String，必填）：媒资类型，取值 video 或 image（大小写不敏感）。
Url（String，与 MediaId 二选一）：媒资 URL，必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头，长度不超过 2048 字符。未注册的 URL 会自动注册为媒资。
MediaId（String，与 Url 二选一）：已注册的媒资 ID。Url 与 MediaId 同时传入时以 MediaId 为准
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en:
The job type. Valid values:

VideoBreakdown: viral video breakdown. The Medias array must contain exactly one element with Type set to video.
ProductRecognition: product image information recognition. All elements in the Medias array must have Type set to image
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。

VideoBreakdown：爆款视频拆解，要求 Medias 恰好包含 1 个 Type=video 的元素；
ProductRecognition：产品图片信息识别，要求 Medias 中全部元素 Type=image
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en: The analysis parameters. It is a JSON string with a maximum length of 65,536 characters and a maximum of 20 fields
parameters.help_zh: 分析参数，JSON 字符串，整体长度不超过 65536 字符，字段总数不超过 20 个
parameters.name: job_params

parameters.help_en: The custom parameters. It is a JSON string that is returned as-is in the callback result, such as newsKey. NotifyAddress is a system-reserved field for the callback URL. A callback is triggered to this URL after the job is completed
parameters.help_zh: 自定义参数，JSON格式字符串，回调结果原样携带（如：newsKey）。系统保留字段 NotifyAddress，回调地址URL，任务完成后回调
parameters.name: user_data

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code. It is an empty string if the submission is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 业务错误码，提交成功时为空字符串
